threads.title: India tightens voter registration and rolls
threads.plain: Authorities are introducing stricter declarations and deleting names from rolls.
threads.claim: Indian authorities are tightening voter‑registration rules and removing names from electoral rolls.

evidence.title: ‘Vote bachao, desh bachao’: Hundreds form human chain against EC, SIR in Hyderabad
evidence.note: Title reports hundreds formed a human chain in Hyderabad protesting the EC and SIR (voter roll revision).

evidence.title: Acted ‘unanimously’ on electoral roll revision orders: Election Commission to Supreme Court
evidence.note: Title says Election Commission told the Supreme Court it ‘acted unanimously’ on electoral roll revision orders.

evidence.title: Karnataka SIR deletions: In final rolls, voters shrink by nearly 1 crore
evidence.note: This story shows large voter‑roll reductions because final rolls in Karnataka shrink by nearly 1 crore after SIR deletions.
evidence.mechanism: This story shows large voter‑roll reductions because final rolls in Karnataka shrink by nearly 1 crore after SIR deletions.

evidence.title: ECI’s stand that additional declaration is not part of Form 6 comes days after SC said it will examine ‘new’ Form 6
evidence.note: This story shows tighter registration rules because the ECI introduced an additional declaration to Form‑6 requiring details of earlier electoral‑roll entries.
evidence.mechanism: This story shows tighter registration rules because the ECI introduced an additional declaration to Form‑6 requiring details of earlier electoral‑roll entries.

teach.one_line: Indian voter-registration rules are getting stricter, and electoral rolls are shrinking as names are removed.
teach.like: Like a club making its sign-up form harder and cleaning out old members.
teach.why: Election regulators are changing registration requirements and cleaning rolls, reflecting the force of regulation.
